title: Digital Notebooks, Section Tabs & Pages
description: Structure ideas across Notebooks, color-coded Section tabs, nested Subpages, and free-form canvas notes.
objectives: Understand Notebook, Section, and Page hierarchy
Type free-form text blocks anywhere on the canvas

steps.title: OneNote Canvas Hierarchy
steps.content: OneNote acts like a digital binder with Notebooks containing color-coded Section tabs, which contain individual dated Pages.

quiz.question: What is the structural hierarchy of content in Microsoft OneNote?
quiz.explanation: OneNote is organized into Notebooks, which contain Section tabs, which contain Pages.

title: Audio Capture & Image OCR Text Extraction
description: Record audio notes, embed PDF printouts, and extract editable text from images using optical character recognition.
objectives: Record audio notes synchronized with typed text
Insert PDF document printouts onto canvas
Right-click images to Copy Text from Picture (OCR)

steps.title: Multimedia Capture & OCR
steps.content: OneNote's OCR engine reads text inside photos, scanned receipts, and PDF printouts, allowing you to search text inside images.

quiz.question: Which OneNote feature extracts editable text from a photo or scanned business card image?
quiz.explanation: Copy Text from Picture uses OCR to convert text inside images into clipboard text.

title: Checklist Tags & Outlook Task Sync Pro
description: Add To-Do interactive tags, search tags across notebooks, and sync meeting notes with Outlook Tasks.
objectives: Apply interactive To-Do, Important, and Question tags
Search tags globally across all notebooks
Sync OneNote action items with Outlook Tasks

steps.title: Tagging & Task Sync
steps.content: Tags flag important action items. Clicking 'Outlook Tasks' converts a note directly into a scheduled Outlook reminder task.

quiz.question: How can you convert a note line in OneNote into a tracked Outlook Task?
options: Click Home Tab -> Outlook Tasks and select a due date
quiz.explanation: The Outlook Tasks button links OneNote action items directly to your Outlook To-Do list.
